coverage_assessment: First pass across all four weekly windows, Spanish and English queries, several Costa Rican regions, labor/public employment, police, education, agriculture, tourism, public finance, social services, transport and local actions, plus month-boundary searches. 15 actual searches produced 376 captured headers. The opened UCR chronology and two exact contemporary report bodies yielded a provisional candidate inventory. Search coverage remains open-web only and incomplete; original report linkage, regional archives, attendance, end dates, source independence and most state responses remain unresolved. A reported absence is not treated as no event.
